plugin.name: stark-ai-developer
plugin.longDescription:
stark AI Developer brings practical workflows for implementation-ready specifications, architecture decisions, structural code analysis, editable diagrams, repository visuals, agent memory, and capability recommendations. Its open-source skills expose their instructions and supporting scripts for review and adaptation.

The package has no shared backend, bundled MCP server, telemetry or analytics. Jev Capability Advisor is an optional Codex workflow: fresh recommendations send your supplied task and public capability descriptions to TypeSafe using your own API key. Offline candidate inspection needs no credential or network. Your host controls discovery, permissions and execution; other tools and services keep their own access requirements.
capabilities: Turn rough feature ideas into implementation-ready specifications.
Compare software architecture options with explicit tradeoffs.
Search code structurally with CodeGraph and ast-grep workflows.
Create editable draw.io diagrams from system context.
Create repository documentation and animated README assets.
Curate durable Codex memory with explicit safety boundaries.
Recommend available skills and tools for a supplied task with Jev in Codex.
starterPrompts: Turn this feature idea into an implementation-ready specification.
Review the available code context and recommend an architecture with explicit tradeoffs.
Create an editable draw.io diagram for this system.

releaseNotes: Adds an adoptable Architecture Compass decision for Tailwind design-system linting with all supported shadcn lint rules enabled by default. Includes ESLint and Oxlint examples, shared UI discovery, scoped component contracts, staged enforcement, and explicit compatibility and evidence boundaries.

skills.name: codex-memory-curator
skills.intent: Safely inspect and curate durable Codex memory with explicit scope and host evidence.
skills.cohesion: Provides the memory-safety workflow needed to preserve implementation context without silently rewriting user state.

skills.name: codex-spec-interviewer
skills.intent: Turn an ambiguous software request into a verified, ADR-gated implementation specification.
skills.cohesion: Provides the requirements and decision boundary that makes the toolkit's other developer workflows actionable.

skills.name: animated-readme-logo
skills.intent: Create or validate repository presentation assets for developer documentation.
skills.cohesion: Keeps repository presentation and documentation assets within the developer workflow promise rather than presenting them as a general art tool.

skills.name: architecture-compass
skills.intent: Review or plan ADR-guided architecture changes with bounded execution authority.
skills.cohesion: Adds architecture tradeoffs and governance evidence between a feature idea and implementation work.

skills.name: codegraph-ast-grep
skills.intent: Set up, update, or diagnose semantic and structural code-search tooling.
skills.cohesion: Supplies repeatable code-context discovery for implementation-ready specifications and structural findings.

skills.name: drawio-diagrams
skills.intent: Create, repair, review, and export editable draw.io diagrams from system context.
skills.cohesion: Turns approved architecture and code context into a concrete, editable developer artifact.

skills.name: jev-capability-advisor
skills.intent: Recommend available skills or MCP tools for a supplied task, or inspect candidates locally.
skills.cohesion: Helps choose an appropriate next workflow from the host-provided catalog without replacing native discovery or execution.
